title: 第十章 破釜沉舟 祭天祷告第十一章 东厂联手 鬼府夺宝
content_zh:
“白玉观音本属于蝶门宗。蝶门宗在武林各派安插的眼线多到让人难以置信。而且蝶门宗宗主的谋略、武功远在幽冥鬼府的凌渊王之上。我携白玉观音并且藏身万锦别院一事，恐怕蝶门宗早已得知！如不出我所料，这次鱼蛇二老必会亲自来拿我。”万青山眼中闪过一丝忧虑。
“啊？这可怎么办？”万青城焦急的说道。
“数月前我放出消息，特意引来幽冥鬼府。因为我素知凌渊王此人贪婪自大，如果得知白玉观音藏在万锦别院，必定会不惜一切代价，将白玉观音弄到手，甚至会铤而走险！到时候，幽冥鬼府与蝶门宗就会鹬蚌相争，自相残杀。这也是不是办法的办法。”万青山说道。
“恩。更何况咱们还有一帮请来的武林高手呢！不怕的。”万青城脸上扬起的得意的神色。
“不，他们都是死棋！”万青山捏须一笑，深不可测的眼神里净是杀机，“钱买来的帮手，不值得信任！我闯荡江湖数年，最基本的一条准则，那便是不能轻易相信外人！”
“死棋？此话怎讲？”万青城疑惑道。
“鱼蛇二老和鬼府中人都是心狠手辣之徒。我故意嘱托你将‘驱鬼台’设在热闹的黄龙街，并且让武林高手们围列‘驱鬼台’周围设宴，还特意将‘假扮的父亲’坐镇驱鬼台，其用意你难道不懂吗？”万青山盯着弟弟微笑道。
“是。。。？”万青城疑惑的思索着。
“咳、咳，傻弟弟，‘白玉观音’只有被用作药引服下，才会出现冷气环绕，冰冻之相！到时候鬼府中人和鱼蛇二老一定会认定台上那满面冰霜的‘万锦王’就是他们要动手的目标！两虎必定会相争。而在旁边，这些你请来帮手也一定会碍于百姓与武林中人的面子去动手帮忙。面子是个可笑的东西，在这帮故作姿态、自视武林之长的‘高手们’眼中更为重要！然而，他们都不会是幽冥鬼府与鱼蛇二老的对手，而且手段狠辣的两虎也必定不会手下留情！这些人都会死的！”万青山低声说道。
“那。。。那不是更糟了吗？”万青城更加疑惑不解了。
“不过，话分两头，以后整个武林便会与幽冥鬼府和蝶门宗为敌！我让你请的这些人都是武林各帮派中有分量的人物。各个帮派不会坐视不管的。而我们老万家，尤其是你，将会是武林中人最为同情的对象。父亲交友广泛，这次患病被掳，随后是旧友们探访被杀，然后又是祸及庭院家人！众人都会哀怜你的。而哥哥会带着‘白玉观音’赴死。不会给你留下任何后患。不过你放心，我就是死了，也会亲手将‘白玉观音’毁坏，谁也别想得到。而你要做的就是，接受武林人士的同情，并且招兵买马，笼络人心。江湖三大正道门派，武当，万佛门，古剑盟。你都要极力拉拢。哥哥给你的天朝金牌你也要拿好了，只要你拿出此物，当年的‘血煞门’余部必会助你一臂之力！还有我给你的《百家秘谱》，其中详细记录了我游历江湖数年收集到的武林各派的深奥武学。其中还记载了部分‘异蝶术’，你要好好练习。振兴我们万家就靠你了！”万青山起身紧紧握住了弟弟的双手，接着说道：“别让哥哥和父亲失望啊！”
“嗯。。。好、好。”万青城拼命地点着头，他呜咽着，都泣不成声了！
黄龙教场，驱鬼台，万人肃目。
此时，黄龙教场上军旗鼓荡，数千禁卫军一起肃立。各门各派都是武林豪客，极少见到这种军纪肃穆的情景，不自禁地三三两两站起身来。
“万锦王到！”随着一声高喝，“万锦王”裹着厚厚的褥被，满脸冰霜，寒气缭绕，身坐雕花大椅，在多名官员的簇拥下，由六名杂役抬着步入会场。在“万锦王”身后数名婢女衣饰华丽，分执炭炉，烟罩。随后，病恹恹的“万锦王”在众人的搀扶下，落座于台中宝座。
“祭天开始！”一名杂役扯着嗓子喊道。随后，“驱鬼台”之上踱入一名六旬老者，此人头扎方巾，狮鼻阔嘴，浓髯乌黑，身上一袭暗紫色长袍，袖襟处攘着一他圈金边，胸前描绣淡墨山水，雨雾翻滚中一只大雕振翅探爪，威势凌人。此人乃是万锦王的表弟，万青城的叔叔，“海砂帮”帮主万远泊，他立在当中，游目四顾，瞧着下方人头耸动，双手挥了挥，众人顿时静了下来。
却听这位老者沉声道：“诸位远来辛苦，万远泊有失照应，惭愧之至。只因我那苦命的侄儿青城，为父亲怪病操劳数日，不眠不休，壮实的汉子，竟也在祭祀前天累倒了。我心痛难当。所以，今天也就由我来带替我那侄儿主持祭祀了！”众人听后议论纷纷，无不露出怜悯之色。
却听万远泊续道：“锦王病重数月，得京师百名御医医治无果。每每看到锦王面露痛楚，遍体冰寒之时，我叔侄二人痛苦难当。我虽一手创立‘海砂帮’，名震岭南，却对锦王患病一事束手无策！”他叹口气，接着说道：“今朝幸得西域奇人来我万家驱邪纳瑞，我甚是感激。无论成果如何，当由天命。”说完屈起右臂，放置左肩向台上两位身披斗篷的卜卦师低头行礼。随后，两位卜卦师依样还礼。
万远泊走至台前，由一名杂役递过一碗酒。他接过酒，朗声说道：“我这第一碗酒，是按照卜卦师的嘱托，祷告天神！”说罢，毕恭毕敬托起海碗，跪拜在地，然后将碗中之酒洒在台前。
随后他接过第二碗酒，继续说道“这第二碗酒，我敬给诸位远道而来的宾客。”万远泊目光灼灼，环视列位宾客一圈。

“啪”异变突生！只见万远泊手中的酒碗应声碎裂，一碗酒浇到了他华贵的锦衣上。惊怒的万远泊咆哮一声，虎目圆瞪，厉声责问道：“谁？！”周围数千禁卫军一齐拔刀出鞘，警惕的向四周巡视。
content_en:
"The White Jade Guanyin originally belongs to the Butterfly Sect. The Diemen Sect has so many spies in various martial arts sects that it is unbelievable. Moreover, the strategy and martial arts of the leader of the Butterfly Sect are far superior to King Lingyuan of the Netherworld Ghost Mansion. I am afraid that the Butterfly Sect has already known that I took the White Jade Guanyin and hid in Wanjin Villa! As expected, the two elders of Fish and Snake will come to get me in person this time." A trace of worry flashed in Wan Qingshan's eyes.
"Ah? What should we do?" Wanqingcheng said anxiously.
"A few months ago, I released the news and specially attracted the Netherworld Ghost Mansion. Because I have always known that King Lingyuan is greedy and arrogant. If I know that the White Jade Guanyin is hidden in Wanjin Villa, I will definitely get the White Jade Guanyin at all costs, and even take risks! When the time comes, the Netherworld Ghost Mansion and the Butterfly Sect will fight with each other and kill each other. This is also not a solution." Wan Qingshan said.
"Yes. What's more, we also have a group of martial arts masters invited! Don't be afraid." A proud look appeared on Wan Qingcheng's face.
"No, they are all dead!" Wan Qingshan pinched his beard and smiled, with murderous intent in his unfathomable eyes. "Helps bought with money are not worthy of trust! I have been in the world for several years, and the most basic rule is that I can't trust outsiders easily!"
"Dead chess? How do you say this?" Wan Qingcheng asked doubtfully.
"Both the Fish Snake Elders and the people in the Ghost Mansion are cruel and ruthless people. I deliberately asked you to set up the 'Ghost Exorcism Stage' in the bustling Huanglong Street, and asked the martial arts masters to gather around the 'Ghost Exorcism Stage' to hold a banquet. I also specially placed the 'pretended father' on the Ghost Exorcism Stage. Don't you understand the purpose?" Wan Qingshan stared at his younger brother and smiled.
"Yes...?" Wanqingcheng thought doubtfully.
"Cough, cough, stupid brother, only when the 'White Jade Guanyin' is taken as a medicine, it will be surrounded by air-conditioning and frozen! At that time, the ghost man and the fish and snake elders will definitely decide that the frost-faced 'Wanjin King' on the stage is their target! The two tigers will definitely fight. And on the side, these helpers you invite will definitely hinder the people. Go and help with the face of people in the martial arts world. Face is a ridiculous thing, and it is more important in the eyes of these "masters" who pretend to be the masters of the martial arts world. However, they will not be the opponents of the Netherworld Ghost Mansion and the two tigers, and the two tigers will definitely not show mercy! "Wan Qingshan said in a low voice!
"Then... wouldn't that be worse?" Wanqingcheng became even more puzzled.
"However, to put it another way, the entire martial arts world will be the enemy of the Netherworld Ghost Mansion and the Diemen Sect in the future! The people I asked you to invite are all important figures in the various gangs in the martial arts world. Each gang will not sit idly by. And our Lao Wan family, especially you, will be the most sympathetic object in the martial arts world. My father has many friends, and this time he is suffering from the disease. You will be taken away by the sick, and then your old friends will be killed. Everyone will pity you. My brother will take the "White Jade Guanyin" to death. But don't worry, even if I die, I will destroy the "White Jade Guanyin" with my own hands, and no one can get it. , accept the sympathy of the martial arts people, and recruit troops to win over people. You must try your best to win over the three righteous sects in the world, Wudang, Wanfo Sect, and Ancient Sword Alliance. You must also take the gold medal from the Heavenly Dynasty that your brother gave you. As long as you show this thing, the remaining members of the "Blood Evil Sect" will definitely help you! "Hundred Schools of Secrets", which contains detailed records of the profound martial arts of various martial arts schools that I have collected during my travels in the world. It also records some of the "Extraordinary Butterfly Techniques". It is up to you to revitalize our Wan family!" Wan Qingshan stood up and held his brother's hands tightly, and then said: "Don't let my brother and father down!"
"Well... Okay, okay." Wanqingcheng nodded desperately, sobbing, and even broke down in tears!
Huanglong SectIn the field, the ghost exorcism stage, tens of thousands of people watched in awe.
At this time, the military flags were flying on the Huanglong teaching field, and thousands of imperial guards stood together. All sects and sects were wealthy martial artists. It was rare to see such a solemn military discipline, so they couldn't help but stand up in twos and threes.
"King Wanjin has arrived!" With a loud shout, "King Wanjin" was wrapped in a thick quilt, his face covered with frost and filled with cold air. He was sitting on a large carved chair. Surrounded by many officials, he was carried into the venue by six servants. Behind "King Wanjin" are several maids in gorgeous clothes, holding charcoal stoves and smoke hoods respectively. Later, with the support of everyone, the sick "King Wanjin" sat on the throne in Taichung.
"The sacrifice to heaven begins!" a handyman shouted at the top of his lungs. Then, an old man in his sixties walked on the "Ghost Exorcist Stage". This man had a square scarf on his head, a lion's nose and a wide mouth, and a thick black beard. He was dressed in a dark purple robe, with a circle of gold on the sleeves, and a light ink landscape embroidered on his chest. In the rolling rain and mist, a large eagle flapped its wings and explored its claws, showing its overwhelming power. This person was Wan Yuanbo, the cousin of King Wanjin, the uncle of Wanqing City, and the leader of the "Sea Sand Gang". He stood in the middle, looking around, watching the heads below, waving his hands, and everyone suddenly fell silent.
But I heard the old man say in a deep voice: "You have come a long way to work hard, and you have not been able to take care of me. I am so ashamed. My poor nephew Qingcheng has been working hard for his father's strange illness for several days without sleep. The strong man actually collapsed from exhaustion the day before the sacrifice. I am heartbroken. Therefore, today I will be the one to lead the sacrifice for my nephew!" After hearing this, everyone talked incessantly, and all showed pity.
But I heard Wan Yuanbo continue: "King Jin has been seriously ill for several months, and he has been treated by hundreds of imperial doctors in the capital to no avail. Every time they see King Jin's face showing pain and his body covered with ice, my uncle and nephew are in unbearable pain. Although I founded the 'Haisha Gang' and became famous in Lingnan, I have no idea about King Jin's illness. There is nothing we can do!" He sighed, and then said: "I am very grateful to have the strange people from the Western Regions come to my house to exorcise the evil spirits. No matter what the result is, it is up to fate." After saying this, he bent his right arm and bowed his head to the two cloaked fortune tellers on the stage. Afterwards, the two fortune tellers returned the favor.
Wan Yuanbo walked to the stage and was handed a bowl of wine by a handyman. He took the wine and said loudly: "My first bowl of wine is to pray to the gods according to the fortune teller's instructions!" After that, he respectfully held up the sea bowl, knelt down on the ground, and then sprinkled the wine in the bowl in front of the stage.
Then he took the second bowl of wine and continued, "I would like to give this second bowl of wine to all the guests who have come from afar." Wan Yuanbo looked around at the guests with burning eyes.
"Pa" a sudden change occurred! The wine bowl in Wan Yuanbo's hand shattered, and a bowl of wine poured onto his luxurious brocade clothes. The frightened and angry Wan Yuanbo roared, his eyes widened, and he asked sternly: "Who?!" Thousands of guards around him unsheathed their swords and patrolled around vigilantly.
